paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua bar Mammal learned from Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah; see Rabbi Yehoshua ben Peter Rosh. Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov asked him, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Gamla, and Yonatan ben Meshullam; see their entries. He lived in the time of Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira; see their entries. Rabbi Elazar ben Shammua learned from Rabbi Yehoshua bar Mammal; see his entry.
